fullContent:
Chaturbhuja Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ayurveda Sar Sangrah 
 Introduction 
 Chaturbhuja Rasa is an herbal mineral formulation. It is helpful in treating epilepsy, chronic fever. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified mercury 
 Gold Bhasma 
 Shilajit/Rock conqueror (Asphaltum) 
 Kasturi (Musk) 
 Purified Arsenic tri oxide 
 Aloe Vera 
 Castor (Ricinus communis) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Combine all the ingredients and triturate with Aloe Vera juice and mix it to form a ball. Warp this ball in castor leaves and let it sit for three days. Take it out and triturate it and when it reaches the consistency of a paste and make pills of 125 mg each. After they’ve dried store them in a clean air tight jar. 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice a day after meals with honey or Triphala decoction. 
 Indications 
 
 Epilepsy 
 Emaciation 
 Parkinson’s disease 
 Chronic fever 
 Paralysis 
 Psychotic diseases 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Consult your doctor in case of over dosage as it may lead to severe neurological side effects. 
 It is better to avoid during pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 Self-medication is discouraged. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
